title: Severe Packet Drop & Interface Saturation
description: Bandwidth saturation detected on Branch West SD-WAN uplink with sustained CRC drops and buffer discards.
suggestedAction: Inspect SD-WAN QoS priority queue, check physical fiber patch cord, verify ISP SLA.

title: Elevated Control Plane CPU & Crypto Engine Load
description: High CPU utilization driven by IPsec crypto tunnel re-keying and bursty ingress traffic on Tunnel0.
suggestedAction: Verify IPsec phase 2 lifetime, inspect rate-limiting policies, check for SYN-flood signatures.

title: EC2 Worker Load Spike
description: Background batch indexing worker process exceeding standard operational baseline.
suggestedAction: Evaluate AWS Auto Scaling trigger to spin up third worker node in us-east-1a.

title: ESXi Host Memory Threshold Warning
description: Hypervisor RAM ballooning detected on 2 guest VMs. DRS rebalancing recommended.
suggestedAction: Trigger DRS migration of dev containers to esxi-node02.prod.

title: Direct Connect Peak Bandwidth Ingress Spike
description: Ingress traffic burst over AWS Direct Connect interface TenGi0/1/0 during data lake synchronization.
suggestedAction: Sync job completed; interface returned to standard baseline (6.42 Gbps).

title: RDS Multi-AZ Automated Snapshot Success
description: Daily automated snapshot created and verified across us-east-1a and us-east-1b.
suggestedAction: No action required. Telemetry status verified.

title: Perimeter Firewall Threat Definitions Updated
description: Automated threat signature database downloaded and activated with zero dropouts.
